affix.simplysmith.lifesteal.desc: Restore %s health from actual attack damage; overhealing becomes absorption
affix.simplysmith.bloodrage.desc: Above 1 health, attacks cost 1 health and deal %s bonus damage
affix.simplysmith.experience_mending.des: While damaged, consumes 1 experience point per tick to restore %s durability
affix.simplysmith.immortal.desc: On death, remain at 1 health; cooldown is %s seconds (minimum 1 second)
affix.simplysmith.dodge.desc: Has a %s chance to evade all damage (maximum 99%%)
config.simplysmith.title: SimplySmith Configuration
config.simplysmith.affix_category.bias.t: Chance that each affix roll is drawn from the item's own category pool instead of the whole pool. Generic affixes count toward every category. Set it to 0 to disable category bias entirely.
jei.simplysmith.enhancement_stone.info: Place the gear in the left anvil slot and an Enhancement Stone in the right slot to raise its enhancement level. Each use consumes 1 Enhancement Stone and costs no experience levels. Enhancing raises every affix on the gear by one level at once, with no level cap. Affixes are rolled when the gear first enters your inventory; enhancing does not change which affixes it has.
jei.simplysmith.breakthrough_stone.info: Place the gear in the left anvil slot and a Breakthrough Stone in the right slot to raise its quality by one tier. Each use consumes 1 Breakthrough Stone and costs no experience levels. A breakthrough tops the gear up to the affix count of its new quality. Gear already at the highest quality cannot break through, and the anvil produces no result.
